Mountain Fury
30 Rage
Instant45 sec cooldown
Move the earth, dealing 492+20.2 Points Per Level+SP*.65+AP*.17+Sta*1.25 Physical damage to up to 12 enemies in a 10 yd frontal cone, pulling them toward you, repeating every 2 sec for 4 sec.

Each time an enemy is pulled toward you, you gain 2% reduced damage taken for 3 sec, stacking 5 times.
